ruleDefinitions.name: Potential DLL Sideloading Via ClassicExplorer32.dll
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading using ClassicExplorer32.dll from the Classic Shell software Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\ClassicExplorer32\\\.dll$") AND  NOT (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Classic\\ Shell\\\\"))
